verdict.rationale: Phaser is a code-first framework, so the game itself is built entirely through its programmatic API: scenes, game objects, physics, input, loader and animations, with TypeScript definitions. Phaser Editor's UI actions (particle emitters, layers, renaming objects) are also exposed to agents via an MCP server with 40+ tools, and project files can move to VS Code. However, nothing documents that every Editor/UI capability (pixel-art/tilemap editors, SFX generation, one-click publish, visual filter tweaking) is reachable programmatically, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, programmatic access to editor-only features like asset editors, SFX generation and publishing, a public REST/OpenAPI surface, and independent corroboration of MCP tool coverage.
